mentions.name: Scharf
mentions.description: Open-source static application security testing (SAST) tool that identifies third-party GitHub Actions prone to supply-chain attacks and automatically fixes them. Written in Go for fast performance.
mentions.problem: Third-party GitHub Actions can be prone to supply-chain attacks, and manually auditing them takes security engineers hours of grind.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Scharf, an open-source SAST tool to identify and auto-fix 3P GitHub actions those are prone to supply-chain attacks. It is blazing fast and written in Go.

evidence.value: I am working on Scharf, an open-source SAST tool to identify and auto-fix 3P GitHub actions those are prone to supply-chain attacks. It is blazing fast and written in Go.
